user.title: Sign in to Anytime Fitness
user.description: Enter the phone number of your Anytime Fitness app account. You will receive an SMS code.

data_description.phone: International format, e.g. +31612345678 (06… is converted to +316…).

code.title: Enter SMS code
code.description: Enter the code that was sent to {phone}.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Anytime Fitness session has expired. Submit to send a new SMS code to {phone}.

error.unknown_account: Could not start a login for this number. Is it the number of your AF account?
error.invalid_code: The code is incorrect or has expired.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Anytime Fitness.

init.title: Clubs and interval
init.description: Your home club is always included. Pick extra clubs nearby or type a club number (e.g. NL-1001).

data_description.clubs: Clubs within 25 km of your home club; you can also type a club number.
